name: gratitude
description: Appreciation for the good fortune of having or receiving something.

variations.name: graceful receiving
variations.description: If it comes with positive feelings towards the giver. there may be reverence, humility, or admiration.

variations.name: indebted receiving
variations.description: If it comes with skeptical or netural feelings towards the giver, may elicit a feeling of indebtedness.

variations.name: really needed this
variations.description: If the object was deeply desired, it may come with delight or relief.

variations.name: existential gratitude
variations.description: If the giving agent is perceived as having been God or the universe, it may come with awe.

commentaries.quote: By turning us outward, gratitude can open us to a bigger perspective, shifting focus from what we lack to what we already have.
Practicing universal gratitude is difficult as it goes against key traits like wanting control and crediting ourselves.

conditions: An agent provided something of value when it wasn't expected to.
